lead: A markup literal's "a brace before a non-`$` is text" does not make the whole braced run inert — a bare `$name` inside that text still interpolates.
body: `{Core\Html::join($nothing, "" as Core\Html\Markup)}` reads as one text segment and is three: the text `{Core\Html::join(`, a simple-syntax interpolation of `$nothing`, and the rest — so an `array` operand there is `E0707: no string form` at a line that looks like a static call. Put the call in a local and write `{$local}`; the hole grammar is the double-quoted string's, **both** halves of it (`rule:core-classes/html-literal`).
